description: Hawaii motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Hawaii rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Hawaii age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Hawaii?

provenance.manual: HRS §286-81 Motorcycle, motor scooter, etc.; protective devices

questions.q: What does Hawaii law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Hawaii: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: HRS §291C-153 Operating motorcycles on roadways laned for traffic

questions.q: What does Hawaii require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Hawaii: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: Hawaii eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

provenance.manual: HRS §286-81 Motorcycle, motor scooter, etc.; protective devices

questions.q: In Hawaii, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Hawaii issues a motorcycle permit at 15½ years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Hawaii motorcycle permit: 15½ years at the earliest.

questions.q: In Hawaii, who must complete a motorcycle safety course before getting a motorcycle license?
options: Not required, but it can replace the riding test
questions.explanation: Hawaii: a motorcycle safety course is required for every new rider.
questions.remember: Hawaii safety course: required for every new rider.
